rules.title: Live downstream dependency without virtualisation
rules.message: Rule book §2: tests must use WireMock or Testcontainers, not shared staging.
rules.fix: Point at a Testcontainers instance or a WireMock stub.

rules.title: Retries above the agreed cap of 1
rules.message: Rule book §3: retries are capped at 1; more hides real flakiness.
rules.fix: retries: 1 — quarantine anything that still fails.

rules.title: Quarantined test without a ticket reference
rules.message: Rule book §4: a quarantined test needs a tracking ticket, or it is never coming back.
